t: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts

t: Tune In to the Midnight Heart
d: The broadcasting club members celebrate the success of sports day with a party at Lemon's house. Iko calls out to sleeping Arisu, wondering why he was hugging Shinobu during the festival.

d: Colt pleads with Zeke to not use his scream and turn Falco into a Titan. All the while, soldiers and Titans clash in battle as Eren struggles to make contact with his brother.

d: Who started these 2,000 years of conflict and war? Eren speaks with Founder Ymir. “I'm sure you've been waiting for someone… since 2,000 years ago.”.
